caveats: Correlations are observational; adjacent submaps and shared scenes invalidate simple independent-sample p-value interpretations.
First-camera z de-stretch is a coordinate diagnostic, not known-K inference or a model focal intervention.
Axis slopes are weakly identified where the GT motion has little energy in that axis.
Principal-point fractions assume full-frame resized images; inspect actual loader crop/pad to recover exact GT K.
